grammar.summary: 本课学习表"发现/辨认"的感官结构复现。

points.title: 感官动词 + 宾语 + doing/do
points.explanation: He noticed the balloon was moving. notice/see/hear + doing（进行中的动作）或 do（完整动作）。

examples.en: The police were told that a balloon had been seen.
examples.cn: 警察被告知有人看见过一只气球。

points.title: 表解释的 for 短语
points.explanation: He was surprised at what he saw. at + what 从句表惊讶的对象。

examples.en: One of them was holding a pair of binoculars.
examples.cn: 其中一人拿着一副双筒望远镜。

exercises.q: I lost my lecture notes and had to make ___ a new set.
When it got dark we made ___ home.
How can you make ___ all those lessons you missed? （填空）
